rules.statement: Do not skip, disable, delete or weaken existing tests or their assertions to make a change pass; fix the code or update the test to the new correct behavior.
rules.why: Skipped or weakened tests are a shortcut that hides broken behavior while the checks still pass.
rules.check: Look for added Skip attributes, commented-out or deleted tests, loosened assertions (e.g. exact checks replaced with NotNull or broader ranges), or removed test cases without a matching behavior change that justifies it.

rules.statement: Do not swallow exceptions or errors; catch only what you can handle and otherwise propagate, log or surface the failure.
rules.why: Swallowed errors are a shortcut that hides failures instead of handling them.
rules.check: Look for empty catch blocks, catch-all handlers that discard the exception, or ignored error results without a documented reason.

rules.statement: Do not leave TODO, FIXME or placeholder comments or stub implementations in finished changes; complete the work or file it as a separate follow-up.
rules.why: Leftover TODOs mean a step was done with shortcuts instead of done as written.
rules.check: Search the diff for added TODO/FIXME/HACK comments, NotImplementedException stubs, or placeholder logic.
